view.label: Webhook view
view.hint: Switch between the subscriptions list and the delivery log.

branchNotice: Subscriptions are managed at company or tenant level.

states.notFound: This webhook record no longer exists.

conflict.title: This record changed
conflict.text: Someone else saved newer changes. Reload the latest data, or keep your changes and save again.

code.label: Code
code.hint: Unique uppercase code starting with a letter (letters, digits, and underscores, 2 to 80 characters).

endpointUrl.label: Endpoint URL
endpointUrl.hint: HTTPS URL where Trade sends signed webhook deliveries (ports 443 or 8443 only). A saved subscription shows only the address and path; enter the full URL again to change it.

retryPolicy.label: Retry policy
retryPolicy.hint: Waits {{t1}}, then {{t2}}, {{t3}}, {{t4}}… up to 6 hours between tries.

maxAttempts.label: Max attempts
maxAttempts.hint: Maximum delivery tries before marking a delivery as gave up (1 to 10).

branches.label: Branches
branches.hint: Limit deliveries to selected branches, or leave empty to include all branches.

validation.codePattern: Use 2–80 uppercase letters, digits, or underscores starting with a letter.
validation.maxAttemptsRange: Enter a whole number between 1 and 10.
validation.atLeastOneField: Keep at least one field selected for each event.

endpointProblems.FRAGMENT_FORBIDDEN: Remove the # fragment from the URL
endpointProblems.NO_FRAGMENT: Remove the # fragment from the URL
endpointProblems.LOCALHOST_FORBIDDEN: Localhost and .local hosts are not allowed
endpointProblems.NO_LOCALHOST: Localhost and .local hosts are not allowed
endpointProblems.SECRET_QUERY_KEY: Remove secret-like words from the query
endpointProblems.SECRET_IN_QUERY: Remove secret-like words from the query

unsaved.title: Discard changes?
unsaved.text: You have unsaved changes to this subscription.

eventsSection.title: Events
eventsSection.caption: Only the checked fields are sent
eventsSection.keepOneField: At least one field must stay included.
eventsSection.maxReached: You can select up to 30 events.
eventsSection.listHint: Select the events this subscription delivers, then choose which payload fields each event includes.

secret.title: Signing secret
secret.caption: Reveal works once, within 15 minutes of activation.

rotateModal.title: Rotate signing secret
rotateModal.overlapHint: The old secret keeps working this long.
rotateModal.overlapRange: Enter a whole number between 30 and 168.

revokeConfirm.title: Revoke signing secret?
revokeConfirm.text: Deliveries stop until a new secret is created.

reveal.title: Signing secret
reveal.fieldHint: Store this HMAC signing key in your receiving system to verify request signatures.
reveal.warning: This secret is shown only once. Store it in your receiving system now.
reveal.alreadyShown: The secret can no longer be shown. Rotate it to get a new one.
reveal.loadError: Could not load the signing secret.
reveal.storedHint: The secret is shown only once. Confirm you have stored it before closing this window.

deliveries.title: Webhook deliveries
deliveries.emptyFiltered: No deliveries match the selected filters.

steps.label: Filter deliveries by status
steps.hint: Filter the webhook deliveries by status
